work_order_description: Character Director corrective work order for ep01_shot01. Derived from accepted corrective_plan.json actions cd-001 through cd-004. All items required before controlled retry authorization.
issue_summary: Retry #2 frames rejected due to extremely low visual quality and character identity instability. Primary cause identified as model/checkpoint incompatibility with desired character type (realvisxlV50_v50Bakedvae.safetensors).

corrective_tasks.description: Evaluate whether current checkpoint (realvisxlV50_v50Bakedvae.safetensors) can reliably render the specified character type. Document findings with explicit pass/fail verdict.
corrective_tasks.completion_criteria: Written evaluation with checkpoint compatibility verdict (compatible/incompatible) and supporting rationale

corrective_tasks.description: If current checkpoint is inadequate, specify alternative model/checkpoint recommendation that better supports the character type. Include model name, version, and justification.
corrective_tasks.completion_criteria: Explicit checkpoint recommendation with model name/path and character compatibility rationale

corrective_tasks.description: Revise character identity guidance and specification to be compatible with the selected checkpoint. Update positive/negative prompt guidance, identity preservation requirements, and consistency targets.
corrective_tasks.completion_criteria: Revised character identity specification document with updated prompt guidance and identity preservation requirements

corrective_tasks.description: Define reference and identity preservation requirements for retry. If character specification changes, provide updated reference images compatible with the new checkpoint style.
corrective_tasks.completion_criteria: Updated reference image path(s) or explicit confirmation that existing reference remains valid for revised specification

joint_gate_dependency.description: Character Director work order must be completed and reviewed before controlled retry can be authorized. Retry remains blocked until joint-001 (corrective_plan_approval) gate is cleared by both Character Director and Workflow TD.
joint_gate_dependency.retry_authorized_by: joint approval of both role work orders
